_about: Language Lab activity library: booth and event activities to reuse. One entry per activity. status: page = a live page in this folder; used = run at an event (no page); idea = saved for later. Edit here; activities/index.html reads this file.

activities.title: What's your 띠? Korean zodiac finder
activities.supplies: iPad or a phone (QR code on the page); optional printed zodiac cards
activities.summary: Visitors type their birth year, meet their zodiac animal and its year color, say "저는 ___띠예요", and check compatibility with a friend.

activities.title: Say it, get a taste
activities.supplies: A phrase on the board; the booth's food
activities.summary: Visitors read one phrase off the board (e.g. 새해 복 많이 받으세요, "Happy New Year") and say it to get a sample.

activities.title: New Year wish wall (소원)
activities.supplies: Sticky notes, pens, an empty strip on the trifold
activities.summary: Visitors write a wish on a sticky note and add it to the board.

activities.title: Sebae: the New Year bow (세배)
activities.supplies: Take-home cards as "New Year money" (세뱃돈); chocolate coins if ordered ahead
activities.summary: Watch and try the bow, say 새해 복 많이 받으세요, receive New Year money and a blessing.

activities.title: Throw the yut: your New Year animal (윷)
activities.supplies: 4 craft sticks (one side marked), a towel to throw on, the result chart
activities.summary: Toss four sticks, count the flat sides: 도 pig, 개 dog, 걸 sheep, 윷 cow, 모 horse. Needs sticks bought ahead.

activities.title: Gonggi (공기)
activities.summary: Toss one stone, grab one off the table, catch the first before it lands.

activities.title: Ddakji (딱지)
activities.supplies: 6–10 paper tiles folded ahead (folding at the table is slow)
activities.summary: Throw a folded paper tile to flip your opponent's.

activities.title: Find Your Taste Twin
activities.supplies: Taste Twin cards (4 per sheet), pens, candy at each table
activities.summary: Tick the flavors you notice in each candy; your top flavor names your "taste twin" countries, then compare with their flavor maps.
used_at: Lingo Café & Candies Around the World, Oct 28, 2026

activities.title: Ask · Taste · Thank
activities.summary: Ask for the food, name a flavor, say "Delicious!" and thank you in each table's language.
used_at: Lingo Café & Candies Around the World, Oct 28, 2026
